entities.summary: Ruddy Rosario Rodríguez de Lucía is a Venezuelan actress, businesswoman, model and beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Venezuela World 1985. She represented Venezuela in the 1985 Miss World pageant in England where she placed in the top seven.
